skills.name: Healing Magic
skills.description: Heals with water mana. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Hit Rate +30% (7 sec) *attack range +15% (7 sec)

skills.name: Mabeast! Mabeast! Mabeast!
skills.description: Becomes a demon, loses reason and attacks fiercely. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK x 4000% Area Damage  *Moves enemies to the back

abilities.name: Group: Re:ZERO
abilities.description: Re:ZERO Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Silence: Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a high chance of making all Intelligence type enemies' Skills unusable and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
